summary:
A distinguished software engineer and solutions architect with over a quarter-century of frontline engineering leadership. Specializes in designing, developing, and deploying mission-critical enterprise platforms, distributed financial switches, high-volume telecom gateways, and IoT infrastructure.

Instrumental in building Indonesia's foundational digital platforms—from early Telkom web portals and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) in the early 2000s, to Telkomsel's ISO 8583 recharge switching gateway operating continuously since 2003, and Telkom Group's modern enterprise platforms including Telkom eRUPS (Shareholders General Meeting built on Odoo ERP), Telkom Threat Map, Data Center Monitoring Performance (DCMP), and Java Spring Boot enterprise supplier management.

Deep polyglot mastery across Java Spring Boot, Python (Odoo ERP, FastAPI, Django), Node.js, PHP, C#/.NET, Oracle, PostgreSQL, and Linux kernel/server administration. Combines rigorous architectural governance with hands-on technical execution to deliver resilient, high-throughput systems that power national corporations and millions of end-users.

experiences.companyDesc: Telkomsigma is Indonesia's leading ICT Solutions and Services provider under Telkom Indonesia Group.
highlights: Architected and delivered the enterprise-grade Supplier Management System using Java Spring Boot and Oracle Database, managing vendor lifecycle, automated procurement, RFQ workflows, purchase orders, and supplier performance evaluation.

Engineered the Telkom eRUPS (Electronic General Meeting of Shareholders) platform for PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk utilizing the Odoo ERP framework, customized Python modules, and PostgreSQL, ensuring legally compliant electronic voting, real-time quorum calculations, secure audit trails, and zero-downtime execution during high-visibility national shareholder meetings.

Built the Data Center Monitoring Performance (DCMP) system (dcmp.sigma.my.id), providing real-time telemetry, capacity forecasting, and proactive incident management across Tier-3 and Tier-4 data centers.
Engineered the Telkom Threat Map, visualizing real-time cyber attack vectors and cybersecurity defensive telemetry across the Telkom national internet backbone.

Architected DigiHotel Property Management System (PMS) and DigiHotel FAB Payment Gateway (pay.digihotel.id), an end-to-end hospitality ERP covering room bookings, inventory, payroll, and automated online payment gateway settlements.
Designed and implemented IoT telematics systems for Telkom Property: Mybirawa TMS (vehicle inspection integrated with onboard IoT sensors) and MyDEFA (periodic supply chain asset compliance).
Developed C3 Omnichannel & AI Chatbot platform, uniting multi-channel customer communications into a unified agent workspace.
Implemented the PSAK 71 financial asset impairment calculation engine for Bank Malut according to national banking regulatory compliance.

experiences.companyDesc: Designated local partner of LENCO Mobile, an international telecom technology provider specializing in multimedia messaging and value-added mobile solutions.
highlights: Architected the MMS Campaign Platform (id01.lencommsc.com) powered by MBuni MMS Gateway, delivering high-volume mobile coupons, QR codes, Microsoft tags, and mobile banking statements for major telecom operators.
Engineered Zona Seru Telkomsel (zonaseru.com), an enterprise multi-channel digital application distribution portal serving millions of content downloads across ODP, SMS, WAP, and Web.

Pioneered early Web3 and cryptocurrency applications in Indonesia: created automated bot platforms on the STEEM blockchain (steem.farinside.com) and Indocell (indocell.my.id), an automated airtime recharge gateway settled in cryptocurrency.
Developed and published native/hybrid Android applications under 'Farinside Dev' on the Google Play Store.
Supervised system design, database indexing, and 24/7 server infrastructure operations for high-concurrency telecom traffic.

experiences.companyDesc: Specialized engineering firm delivering spatial data infrastructure and Geographic Information Systems (GIS).
highlights: Organized, maintained, and engineered advanced GIS Systems for Mining Solutions using ESRI ArcGIS suite (ArcView, ArcMap, ArcGlobe).
Integrated spatial geospatial databases with enterprise desktop and web clients to visualize mining concession boundaries, vehicle tracking, and geological surveying.
